DirectEdit's edit leverage collapses when ψ_src is structurally far from Anima's training-time embedding manifold — Anima Tagger fixes that vs. a generic WD-tagger. Caption pre-fill for LoRA training. Tag your dataset, paste into .txt sidecars. Prompt scaffolding.
